buildings.name: ocbox CLI
buildings.summary: The ocbox command on a developer's machine. Signs in with OAuth, starts and destroys boxes, syncs local files and runs commands through the hosted API, and can route a coding agent's shell commands into the box.

areas.name: Commands and configuration
areas.summary: Command entry points, project selection, output and runtime composition.

areas.name: Authentication
areas.summary: Browser PKCE login, credential-bound HTTP and serialized token rotation.

areas.name: Session lifecycle
areas.summary: Local Session state and reconciliation with the hosted Session.

areas.name: Command execution
areas.summary: Helper protocol, cancellation, output and command exit codes.

areas.name: Source synchronization
areas.summary: Manifest scanning, planning, archives, hosted push and local recovery.

areas.name: Coding-agent adapters
areas.summary: Owned settings, version gates, setup/remove plans and command hooks.

areas.name: Local state and credentials
areas.summary: Where local files live (platform paths), the file lock and atomic replace, protected credential files and non-secret project state, each locked.

areas.name: Public API client
areas.summary: Generated OpenAPI calls, hosted provider, polling and metadata.

areas.name: Provider contract and fixtures
areas.summary: Capability interface plus contract/fake providers for local validation.

areas.name: Domain and validation
areas.summary: Local specification, Session state, Operation transitions and identifiers.

areas.name: Project configuration
areas.summary: opencloudbox.toml: strict schema, parsing, migration and value precedence.

areas.name: Output envelopes
areas.summary: One writer for human, JSON and JSON-lines output, with redaction.

areas.name: Typed errors
areas.summary: The public error catalogue: codes, retryability and redacted details.

areas.name: Redaction and path safety
areas.summary: Secret and host-path redaction, sensitive-material scans and the symlink-escape path boundary.

buildings.name: Local state
buildings.summary: Historical map grouping retained to preserve human notes. Current state and credential code belongs to the ocbox CLI state area; it is not a separately deployed service.

buildings.name: Coding agents
buildings.summary: Claude Code and Codex on the developer's machine. After ocbox agent setup, their Bash tool calls go through an ocbox hook and run in the box instead of locally.

buildings.name: Source upload endpoints
buildings.summary: Opaque upload URLs returned by the public source plan. The CLI sends blob bytes by credential-free PUT; this repo does not identify their infrastructure.

code.name: ocbox start
code.summary: Creates, resumes or reconciles the selected session for this project and waits until the hosted sandbox is ready.

code.name: ocbox exec
code.summary: Parses argv or explicit --shell and executes in the selected Session. The hosted adapter shell-quotes argv into the API command string; the fake adapter starts the local helper. Returns the execution outcome exit code.

code.name: ocbox sync push
code.summary: Applies local-only changes to the session workspace. Deletions need --delete and confirmation.

code.name: ocbox destroy
code.summary: Destroys a session after explicit confirmation and waits for the hosted operation to finish.

code.name: ocbox auth login
code.summary: Signs the CLI in to the hosted API through the browser.

code.name: AuthSessionService.login
code.summary: Binds a loopback listener, opens the authorize URL with a PKCE challenge, waits for the callback, exchanges the code and commits the token pair under the auth gate. Always closes the listener.

code.name: LoopbackCallbackListener
code.summary: One-shot HTTP listener on 127.0.0.1 at /callback that receives the authorization code and checks state.

code.name: codeChallengeS256
code.summary: PKCE S256 challenge from a random verifier, so a stolen code is useless without the verifier kept in memory.

code.name: HostedTokenManager
code.summary: Hands out a valid access token, refreshing when it is about to expire. Rotation happens at most once per generation across processes, so parallel commands don't burn the refresh token.

code.name: HostedOAuthCredentialStore
code.summary: Credential selection port: available OS adapter or protected-file fallback, selected before use. The default runtime wires the protected-file path; project metadata holds only a reference.

code.name: LifecycleStore
code.summary: Atomic JSON store for the selected session and the mapping from local sandbox ids to hosted session ids.

code.name: LifecycleService
code.summary: Starts the selected Session: create when absent or --new, continue an interrupted create, refresh active state, resume paused or start stopped; incompatible states fail instead of silently replacing the Session.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.create
code.summary: Hosted create: sends createSession (only the requested resources, with the idempotency key), turns admission denials into plain errors, waits for the operation and for a running primary binding, and saves the local-to-hosted mapping.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.#execute
code.summary: Calls createExecution with an idempotency key. A 404 marks the local mapping stale. Then polls events until the command finishes or the deadline passes.

code.name: runExecutionCommandResult
code.summary: Parses arguments, starts the command, streams output, handles cancellation and maps exit codes. Typed errors before or after start keep their safe code/message; other failures retain the generic infrastructure result.

code.name: runSyncApply
code.summary: Serializes Session sync; routes mapped fast-path pushes to CAS v2, older hosted Sessions to archive upload, and fake/local transfers to baseline planning and recovery.

code.name: scanSourceManifest
code.summary: Walks the project folder with ignore rules and path policy, recording each file's size, mode and SHA-256. Blocks symlinks and paths that escape the root.

code.name: planSync
code.summary: Three-way comparison of local, remote and a verified baseline: classifies additions, edits, deletions, renames and conflicts for push, pull or diff without changing either tree.

code.name: encodeSyncArchive
code.summary: Encodes a canonical snapshot as an OCBOXA1 header and per-entry metadata/content records; verifies each opened file against its declared size and SHA-256 while streaming.

code.name: uploadPreparedSource
code.summary: Reuses a matching verified manifest if one exists, otherwise creates a manifest, uploads each chunk, verifies the checksum and polls the apply operation.

code.name: createHostedApiClient
code.summary: Generated OpenAPI client with an authenticated transport: adds the bearer token and, for replayable requests only, refreshes once on 401 and retries. Errors stay redacted.

code.name: DEFAULT_API_URL
code.summary: Defines the default public API base used when no API URL override or stored login binding selects another issuer.

code.name: runClaudeRoutingHook
code.summary: Reads the agent's PreToolUse JSON. For a covered Bash call it runs the command with ocbox exec in the box, then always answers deny with the remote result as the reason, so the local copy never runs.

code.name: planSetup
code.summary: ocbox agent setup claude-code: writes an owned hook entry into the agent's settings, idempotently, and can be undone with ocbox agent remove.

code.name: AuthSessionService.status
code.summary: Checks credential identity, canonical issuer, client and scopes under the auth state lock. Missing credentials clear stale metadata; inconsistent stores raise INVALID_STATE.

code.name: AuthSessionService.logout
code.summary: Attempts token revocation, then clears local credentials and metadata even when the network fails; local cleanup failures are reported.

code.name: AuthenticatedHttpClient.request
code.summary: Binds bearer use to API origin and deployment subpath; permits one 401 refresh/retry only for replay-safe requests.

code.name: createSessionGate
code.summary: Serializes login commits, logout, credential reads and refresh across CLI processes using auth.state.lock.

code.name: waitForHostedOperation
code.summary: Polls an operation with validated checkpoints, Retry-After and a default 5-minute deadline; source apply uses a 1-second healthy interval.

code.name: collectExecutionEvents
code.summary: One 331-line event-collection state machine: orders/deduplicates output, checkpoints cursors and falls back to polling after bounded stream failures. Its stage closures share cursor/deadline state.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.#mutate
code.summary: Sends start/pause/stop/destroy against the public API and reconciles the resulting hosted Session under a lifecycle deadline.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.cancelSandboxExecution
code.summary: Finds the active hosted Execution, requests cancellation and waits for a terminal result instead of assuming cancellation succeeded.

code.name: LifecycleService.status
code.summary: Refreshes the selected local Session against provider observations and updates its safe public view.

code.name: LifecycleService.list
code.summary: Returns local Session views; state reads retain the project identity and selected Session.

code.name: LifecycleService.use
code.summary: Selects an existing Session after validating it belongs to the current local project.

code.name: runHostedPush
code.summary: Hosted push refuses remote deletion; scans at most 100 files, 64 KiB each and 512 KiB total, then sends an archive capped at 1 MiB.

code.name: runSyncDiff
code.summary: Builds a read-only comparison against manifests and the verified baseline; hosted capability checks can refuse unsupported operations.

code.name: runSyncRecover
code.summary: Recovers an interrupted local transfer journal under the sync lock; hosted recovery is refused when the capability is absent.

code.name: runExecutionHelper
code.summary: Exec helper validates a protocol request, emits bounded events and turns timeout or interruption into cancellation before its terminal result.

code.name: planCodexSetup
code.summary: One 317-line pure setup planner: checks trust/ownership, computes expected file hashes and emits an atomic change plan. Its branches share the prospective documents; apply is a separate mapped method.

code.name: applyCodexChangePlan
code.summary: Writes planned backups and changes in order; on failure restores completed changes in reverse order. It does not re-read target fingerprints before overwriting; incomplete rollback raises CODEX_ROLLBACK_FAILED.

code.name: planMerge
code.summary: Plans an ownership-aware merge of routing hooks and permissions; existing unrelated settings survive, while collisions and ambiguous owned entries are reported.

code.name: parseSettingsJson
code.summary: Parses settings JSON into validated hook/permission records and preserves parse findings instead of trusting malformed agent configuration.

code.name: parseOwnedCodexCommand
code.summary: Recognizes the exact adapter-owned hook command and arguments; unrelated commands do not become removable merely because they mention the CLI.

code.name: resolveCodexPaths
code.summary: Resolves the Codex home (CODEX_HOME if absolute, else ~/.codex), user and project config.toml and hooks.json, per-layer manifest and backup paths. Owned writes are limited to these roots by the path boundary checks.

code.name: editTomlHooks
code.summary: Edits only the owned hooks table in config.toml by splicing text: surgical for existing [[hooks.*]] blocks, region for an inline [hooks] table, append when absent. Comments and formatting elsewhere stay byte-identical.

code.name: checkCodexVersion
code.summary: Parses and gates the detected version against pinned releases; ambiguous suffixes or unsupported versions produce capability findings.

code.name: resolveExecutableOnPath
code.summary: Resolves executable candidates from PATH and platform extensions without treating an arbitrary existing file as a runnable agent binary.

code.name: mapApiFailureToOcboxError
code.summary: Maps status, public error envelope and safe request/retry metadata to the CLI error catalogue; unexpected raw provider response bytes are not forwarded.

code.name: normalizeIssuer
code.summary: Normalizes the API issuer base and refuses credentialed URLs, fragments or off-loopback cleartext transport before protocol endpoints are derived.

code.name: CliOAuthClient.exchangeAuthorizationCode
code.summary: Posts the authorization code with its original verifier and redirect URI, bounds the response and validates the token pair before storage.

code.name: createHostedTokenManager
code.summary: Builds the hosted token manager: tokens are read and rotated only through the credential store, behind the cross-process refresh gate, bound to the issuer, client and credential identity recorded in auth.json.

code.name: createLifecycleService
code.summary: Builds the selected project LifecycleService, local state store and provider registry from validated configuration, flags and API credentials.

code.name: runAgentHookSafely
code.summary: Fail-closed boundary of ocbox agent hook claude-code: any unexpected error while reading stdin, routing, running exec or writing the decision becomes an ocbox-block[guard] deny with exit 2, because Claude Code treats other exit codes as a non-blocking warning.

code.name: removeCodexLayer
code.summary: Codex removal for one layer: reads the manifest (or a legacy one) and the current files, plans the removal, reports repair steps when ownership is unclear and, with --yes, applies it after checking every path stays inside the Codex root.

code.name: runCodexSetup
code.summary: Codex setup for one layer: reads config.toml, hooks.json, the version, project trust and the Session, then plans. Only with --yes does it check each path stays inside CODEX_HOME or the project and apply; a blocked plan exits 2.

code.name: PowerShellWindowsAclProtector.protectAndVerify
code.summary: Asks the Windows protection helper to establish and verify user-only credential access; failure is propagated rather than weakening protection.

code.name: ProjectSchema
code.summary: Validates local Project IDs, unique Session membership and creation/update ordering; hosted metadata has separate public resource schemas.

code.name: canTransitionSessionState
code.summary: Looks a proposed Session state change up in SESSION_TRANSITIONS; assertSessionTransition adds the evidence checks on top of it.

code.name: OPERATION_ACTIONS
code.summary: Defines the allowed local Operation actions for lifecycle, execution and source work; validation rejects unknown action values.

code.name: SandboxSpecSchema
code.summary: Defines the validated sandbox specification and constraints used by configuration and provider contracts; validation does not prove hosted admission.

code.name: encodeHelperEventFrame
code.summary: Frames one helper event as a 4-byte big-endian length plus JSON (at most 1 MiB, validated against the frame schema). The decoder never buffers more than one frame and throws HelperProtocolError on anything malformed.

code.name: ExecutionService.start
code.summary: Validates selection, bindings, capabilities and deadlines before execution; explicit shell rejects a known non-Linux OS and defers an unobserved OS to the remote executor. Separates command completion from infrastructure or cancellation outcomes.

code.name: createMetadataClient
code.summary: Builds an authenticated API client bound to the configured issuer (endpoints, credential store, token manager). It needs no selected hosted project or Session.

code.name: effectiveMaxSandboxesPerSession
code.summary: Derives the effective sandbox count from provider capability information instead of assuming a generic specification is supported.

code.name: CreateSandboxRequestSchema
code.summary: Validates provider create input and request context at the local contract boundary; actual implementations enforce their advertised capabilities.

code.name: FakeSandboxProvider.create
code.summary: Idempotent create on the local fake provider: the same idempotency key or Session/Operation adopts the existing sandbox, otherwise a running fake-<id> resource is stored in providers/fake.json. A fault option drops the first response to test retries.

code.name: isTerminalOperationState
code.summary: Identifies terminal hosted Operation states for polling and reconciliation; pending/running states require another observation.

code.name: ExclusiveFileLock.#acquire
code.summary: Claims an exclusive local lock with bounded contention and ownership-aware stale recovery; cancellation and timeout do not permit an unlocked update.

code.name: LocalTransferAdapter.recover
code.summary: Recovers a local transfer using its durable journal: never promotes staged content or removes an ambiguous backup; restores the original target or proven absence.

code.name: AgentDoctor.run
code.summary: Dispatches to Codex or Claude Code diagnostics, warns about explicitly supplied flags for the other adapter and emits the adapter findings; an unknown adapter fails.

code.name: AgentHook.run
code.summary: Dispatches stdin hook payloads to the selected adapter through fail-closed wrappers; invalid flags, input or routing failures produce a blocking decision.

code.name: AgentTopic.run
code.summary: Prints agent setup, doctor, remove and hook usage; this topic command changes no settings and makes no API call.

code.name: AgentRemove.run
code.summary: Dispatches ownership-aware removal for Codex or Claude Code; Codex applies only with --yes, while Claude Code removes proven entries immediately.

code.name: AgentSetup.run
code.summary: Selects the adapter, reports irrelevant flags and runs version/ownership planning; Codex requires --yes to apply while Claude Code setup writes immediately.

code.name: AuthTopic.run
code.summary: Prints auth login, status and logout usage; no credential access or authentication request is performed.

code.name: AuthLogin.run
code.summary: Resolves auth services, prints the authorization URL when needed and runs login with browser/no-browser selection and interrupt cancellation; emits only the safe login view.

code.name: AuthLogout.run
code.summary: Creates the local auth service and emits revocation/cleanup facts from logout; usable local cleanup does not depend on a successful network revocation.

code.name: AuthStatus.run
code.summary: Reads the local auth service status and emits issuer, audience, scopes and expiry facts through authStatusLine; tokens are never included.

code.name: Cancel.run
code.summary: Parses an optional hosted execution ID, local --sandbox and --wait-timeout (default 30000 ms); subscribes to Ctrl-C and prints the observed terminal execution state.

code.name: Destroy.run
code.summary: Requires --yes or an interactive y before dispatch; shows hosted deletion progress, invokes lifecycle destroy and always disposes its interrupt subscription.

code.name: EnvironmentCreate.run
code.summary: Dispatches environment.create through MetadataCommand using name and optional stable idempotency key; authenticated request and strict response validation run without a selected Session.

code.name: EnvironmentGet.run
code.summary: Dispatches environment.get through MetadataCommand using required hosted identifier; authenticated request and strict response validation run without a selected Session.

code.name: EnvironmentList.run
code.summary: Dispatches environment.list through MetadataCommand using optional cursor and limit 1–100; authenticated request and strict response validation run without a selected Session.

code.name: EnvironmentUpdate.run
code.summary: Dispatches environment.update through MetadataCommand using identifier plus optional name/selected and idempotency key; authenticated request and strict response validation run without a selected Session.

code.name: Exec.run
code.summary: Passes execution tokens and the selected lifecycle target to the execution runner, subscribes to Ctrl-C and sets process.exitCode from its result.

code.name: Init.run
code.summary: Passes initialization flags to initializeProject and emits project.initialized with a created/validated result; existing configuration is validated before completion.

code.name: ListSessions.run
code.summary: Loads the lifecycle service and prints locally recorded Session views, or No Sessions when empty; --json retains the structured views.

code.name: Pause.run
code.summary: Resolves the selected or explicit Session and invokes capability-gated pause with interrupt cancellation; the hosted provider rejects unsupported memory pause.

code.name: ProjectCreate.run
code.summary: Dispatches project.create through MetadataCommand using name and optional stable idempotency key; authenticated request and strict response validation run without a selected Session.

code.name: ProjectGet.run
code.summary: Dispatches project.get through MetadataCommand using required hosted identifier; authenticated request and strict response validation run without a selected Session.

code.name: ProjectList.run
code.summary: Dispatches project.list through MetadataCommand using optional cursor and limit 1–100; authenticated request and strict response validation run without a selected Session.

code.name: ProjectUpdate.run
code.summary: Dispatches project.update through MetadataCommand using identifier, required name and optional idempotency key; authenticated request and strict response validation run without a selected Session.

code.name: Providers.run
code.summary: Loads configuration, builds the provider registry and emits configured provider plus availability, auth and capabilities; factory failures become unavailable rows.

code.name: Start.run
code.summary: Invokes lifecycle start, passing --new to force a new selected Session; human hosted output displays readiness progress and interrupt listeners are disposed afterward.

code.name: Status.run
code.summary: Resolves the optional Session argument and emits its lifecycle status using sessionViewLine; missing or unknown selection fails with a typed error.

code.name: Stop.run
code.summary: Invokes lifecycle stop for the selected or explicit Session, preserving filesystem according to provider capability; always disposes the interrupt listener.

code.name: SyncDiff.run
code.summary: Resolves roots and Session, parses include/exclude rules and emits runSyncDiff output; hosted diff is refused and local trees are not modified.

code.name: SyncTopic.run
code.summary: Prints sync diff, push, pull and recover usage without resolving a Session, scanning source or transferring files.

code.name: SyncPull.run
code.summary: Resolves the selected Session and roots, then runs local pull with ignore rules and deletion approval; hosted pull is unsupported.

code.name: SyncPush.run
code.summary: Runs push with a cancellable resolved transport and deletion approval. CAS progress becomes human stderr or sync.progress JSONL events; sync.pushed contains the terminal result.

code.name: SyncRecover.run
code.summary: Resolves Session and roots, runs journal/baseline recovery and emits sync.recovered; hosted recovery is refused.

code.name: Use.run
code.summary: Validates the required Session argument, selects it in lifecycle state and emits its public view; selection does not contact the sandbox.

code.name: decideRouting (Claude Code)
code.summary: Decides what a hook call does. Left local: a nested ocbox call (OCBOX_AGENT_ROUTED=1 with adapter claude-code), any tool but Bash, the exact owned hook command. Blocked: Bash with no Session. Otherwise routed as ocbox exec --session <id> --timeout 570000 --shell <command>.

code.name: buildHookCommand (Claude Code)
code.summary: Builds the installed command "ocbox agent hook claude-code [--session <id>]" and parses it back. An id that does not round-trip (padded or containing whitespace) is refused, so setup never installs a hook that doctor and remove could not find.

code.name: recursionGuardArgs (Claude Code)
code.summary: Adds --env OCBOX_AGENT_ROUTED=1 and OCBOX_AGENT_ADAPTER=claude-code to every routed ocbox exec, so a Claude Code running inside the box keeps its own Bash calls local instead of routing them out again.

code.name: assertClaudeHookTimeoutOrdering
code.summary: Pins the installed hook timeout to 600 s and the routed run to 570000 ms (30 s margin). Runs at module load and throws unless the remote timeout is positive and below the hook deadline, so a routed command cannot outlive its hook.

code.name: gateClaudeVersion
code.summary: Accepts only the pinned Claude Code version 2.0.51, read as major.minor.patch from `claude --version`. Any other output returns a remediation message; setup refuses to guess settings schemas for other versions.

code.name: assertClaudeVersionOverrideAllowed
code.summary: The --claude-version override is accepted only when OCBOX_TEST_MODE=1; otherwise it throws UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, so the live version gate cannot be bypassed outside the offline test harness.

code.name: readInstalledClaudeVersion
code.summary: Runs `claude --version` with a 15 s timeout and returns an empty string on any failure, so the version gate reports an unsupported install instead of crashing. A Windows .cmd shim runs through cmd.exe with a checked, quoted path.

code.name: resolveClaudeSettingsLayout
code.summary: Locates Claude Code settings: ~/.claude/settings.json (user), <project>/.claude/settings.json (project), <project>/.claude/settings.local.json (local) and an OS-specific managed policy file. Precedence, high to low: managed, explicit, local, project, user.

code.name: resolveClaudeSettingsSources
code.summary: Lists the settings sources in precedence order. Managed and explicit files are read-only for the adapter; only the local, project and user files can be written.

code.name: evaluatePolicy
code.summary: Reads every settings source and collects managed hook locks at or above the target and deny/ask rules that overlap Bash(ocbox exec:*). Setup stops without writing on an unreadable source, a lock or a shadowing rule.

code.name: permissionRulesOverlap
code.summary: Decides whether two permission rules (Bash, Bash(cmd), Bash(prefix:*)) can match the same command. Used to find deny/ask rules that would shadow the owned allow rule Bash(ocbox exec:*).

code.name: parseOwnedHookCommand (Claude Code)
code.summary: Ownership grammar: only the exact command "ocbox agent hook claude-code" with an optional --session <id> is adapter-owned. Doctor and remove therefore never touch a user hook that merely mentions ocbox.

code.name: writeFileAtomic (Claude Code)
code.summary: Writes settings, manifest and backup files through a temp file in the same folder: fsync, rename over the target (bounded retry on Windows), fsync the folder. Keeps the existing file mode, default 0600; the temp file is removed on failure.

code.name: parseManifestContent (Claude Code)
code.summary: Reads ocbox-claude-code-manifest.json beside the settings file: pinned version, base/applied hashes, backup path, created pointers, protected rules, session and whether setup created the file. Malformed or foreign content returns null.

code.name: assertSettingsPathWithinRoot
code.summary: Refuses a settings file whose real path leaves its .claude folder (symlink, junction or reparse point) or whose link is dangling. The project or home directory itself may be a link.

code.name: CAPABILITY_MATRIX
code.summary: Coverage table returned by doctor: only Bash calls through the PreToolUse hook and explicit ocbox sync are covered. Edit/Write, Read/Grep, web tools, MCP, subagents and Bash with hooks disabled stay local.

code.name: planDoctor (Claude Code)
code.summary: Read-only checks: version, policy sources, managed lock, higher-policy shadow, owned entries, manifest, drift, Session, routing boundary and corruption. The result is ok=false when any check fails; it carries the capability matrix.

code.name: planRemove (Claude Code)
code.summary: Removes only owned hook and permission entries. Restores the backup byte for byte when the file still matches the recorded hashes, deletes a file setup created, otherwise rewrites the pruned document. User-replaced containers are reported, not edited.

code.name: planRemove entries (Claude Code)
code.summary: Pure removal step: filters owned hooks out of hooks.PreToolUse and the owned allow rule out of permissions.allow, counts both, flags a non-array container as container-invalid, and prunes only containers it emptied.

code.name: ClaudeCodeAdapterError
code.summary: Typed adapter failure with a remediation hint. Codes: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA, CORRUPT_SETTINGS, MANAGED_POLICY_PROTECTED, DRIFT_CONFLICT, ROLLBACK_FAILED. In this tree only the version checks throw it.

code.name: stableStringify
code.summary: Serializes JSON with sorted keys. hashJson takes the SHA-256 of this form, so equal settings documents hash identically whatever their key order.

code.name: planCodexHookRoute
code.summary: Pure routing decision. Blocked: unreadable payload, Bash without a command, Bash with no Session. Left local: other events or tools, nested calls (OCBOX_CODEX_ADAPTER_ACTIVE=1) and exact owned ocbox commands. Otherwise routed through ocbox exec.

code.name: buildRoutedExecArgv
code.summary: Maps a covered command to ocbox exec --session <id> --timeout 570000 --env … -- /bin/bash -lc <command>. The recursion markers and session id travel as --env before the -- terminator, so the command text itself is never rewritten.

code.name: parseCodexHookPayload
code.summary: Validates the PreToolUse JSON on stdin: event name (one of 12 known), tool_name, optional session_id and, for Bash, tool_input.command up to 1 MiB. Invalid JSON, an unknown event or a missing tool name returns a reason and the hook fails closed.

code.name: runCodexRoutingHook
code.summary: Codex hook body: parse the payload, decide, run the routed ocbox exec, then print a PreToolUse deny decision and return 0 so Codex skips the local copy. Unreadable input, a block decision or a thrown exec print the deny and return exit 2.

code.name: proveCodexHookContract
code.summary: Offline self-check used by setup and doctor: a sample payload must parse, route to a valid ocbox exec argv with both recursion markers and the 570000 ms timeout. If a step fails, setup does not install the hook.

code.name: assertCodexHookTimeoutOrdering
code.summary: Writes timeout = 600 s onto the installed Codex hook and routes with --timeout 570000 ms (30 s margin). Runs at module load and throws unless the remote timeout is positive and below the hook deadline.

code.name: fragmentId
code.summary: Names an owned hook fragment ocbox-codex- plus the first 32 hex characters of the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON (event, matcher, group), so the same desired hook always gets the same id.

code.name: parseTomlDocument
code.summary: Parses config.toml. A file over 4 MiB or with invalid TOML raises CODEX_CONFIG_INVALID; the adapter never rewrites a file it cannot parse.

code.name: parseHooksJsonDocument
code.summary: Parses hooks.json: an empty file counts as absent; over 4 MiB, invalid JSON or a non-object raises CODEX_HOOKS_INVALID instead of being overwritten.

code.name: canonicalJson (Codex)
code.summary: Key-sorted JSON used to derive fragment ids and compare hook groups independent of key order; the same file holds the path helpers and deepEqual used by the hook-table edits.

code.name: detectCodexInstallation
code.summary: Reads `codex --version`, config.toml and hooks.json together: gates the version, validates any existing hooks table and reports which representations (config-toml, hooks-json) already hold hooks.

code.name: validateHooksTable
code.summary: Rejects a hooks table that is not an object, names an event outside the 12 known ones, or holds non-array events or non-object groups (CODEX_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED). The adapter will not edit a table it does not recognise.

code.name: CodexAdapterManifestSchema
code.summary: Per-layer ownership record at <state>/agents/codex/<layer>/manifest.json: Codex version, schema revision, representation, config/hooks paths, session id, up to 256 owned fragments, SHA-256 of each file, whether setup created them, backup paths.

code.name: parseLegacyCodexManifest
code.summary: Lenient reader for two older single-file manifest shapes, so hooks they left behind are found by strict ownership and repaired instead of staying as orphans.

code.name: resolveSessionSelection
code.summary: Picks the Session for the hook: --session if given, else activeSessionId in <state>/lifecycle/<projectId>.json. It also reports whether that Session exists in the file. A missing or unreadable file means no Session.

code.name: resolveProjectTrustLevel
code.summary: Project-layer trust: a trust_level = "trusted" entry for the repository in the user config.toml wins; otherwise the layer file is consulted. An untrusted or unknown verdict keeps setup and doctor fail-closed.

code.name: writeFileAtomic (Codex)
code.summary: Temp file with mode 0600 beside the target, fsync, rename over it (bounded retry on Windows); the temp file is removed on failure. Used for config.toml, hooks.json, manifests and backups.

code.name: readInstalledCodexVersion
code.summary: Runs `codex --version` with a 15 s timeout, finding codex, codex.exe, codex.cmd or codex.bat on PATH, and returns an empty string on failure so checkCodexVersion reports the real status.

code.name: CodexAdapterError
code.summary: Typed failure with code, remediation and optional details: unsupported version or schema, invalid config, hooks or manifest, untrusted project, unsafe path, apply failure and rollback failure.

code.name: capabilityMatrix (Codex)
code.summary: Coverage statement returned by doctor: Bash calls matching the owned PreToolUse hook and explicit ocbox sync are covered; editors, direct shell, network, MCP, computer use and background agents stay local.

code.name: detectCodexDrift
code.summary: Compares the manifest with the files now on disk: unparseable files give corrupted; a missing or changed owned fragment, or a changed config/hooks SHA-256, gives drifted; no manifest gives no-manifest; otherwise clean.

code.name: computeThreeWayRepair
code.summary: Three-way choice for an owned hook: missing → recreate; equals desired → already-desired; unchanged since recorded → take-desired; anything else → preserve-both so a user edit is never overwritten.

code.name: applyCodexRemovePlan
code.summary: Applies a removal through the same transactional writer as setup. Every touched file (also preserved copies and the manifest) is snapshotted first, so a failure part-way restores the earlier state.

code.name: codexDoctor
code.summary: Checks version, config and hooks parsing, one representation per layer, schema, orphaned hooks, owned entries and drift, selected Session, hook contract, recursion guard and project trust. Each is ok, warning or fail with a remediation.

code.name: removeOwnedFragments
code.summary: Removes owned groups (same event and identical group) from the hooks table, deletes events that become empty and prunes an empty table. Returns how many groups were removed.

code.name: irrelevantFlagWarnings
code.summary: setup, doctor and remove accept both adapters' flags. A flag the chosen adapter does not use (for example --layer with claude-code) is ignored with a warning, and only when the user typed it: values filled from defaults stay silent.

code.name: OcboxCommand
code.summary: Base of product commands. emitResult runs the action and prints the result envelope, or a redacted error with exit code 1; abortOnInterrupt turns SIGINT into an AbortSignal. Shared flags include --config, --json, --jsonl, --no-color and --state-dir.

code.name: sessionViewLine
code.summary: One-line human summary of a Session: * marks the selected one, then id, state, provider state, raw provider state and any running operation.

code.name: loadProjectConfig
code.summary: Reads opencloudbox.toml (or --config) relative to the working directory and validates it. A missing file raises CONFIG_INVALID "run ocbox init".

code.name: resolveStateDirectory
code.summary: State directory precedence: --state-dir, then OCBOX_STATE_DIR, then the platform default. Lifecycle, sync, provider and auth files all live under it.

code.name: createRegistry
code.summary: Registers deferred factories for fake local validation and the hosted ocbox provider; LifecycleService binds its project store after provider resolution.

code.name: initializeProject
code.summary: Creates opencloudbox.toml exclusively (mode 0600) or validates and completes an existing one. Default provider is ocbox after login, otherwise fake. For ocbox it finds or creates a hosted project named after the folder, paging until a repeated cursor aborts.

code.name: DEFAULT_PROJECT_CONFIG
code.summary: Starter file: provider fake, linux x86_64, 1000 millicores, 2 GiB memory, 10 GiB disk, open egress, idle timeout 15 min, maximum runtime 2 h, auto-stop 30 min, auto-destroy 3 h.

code.name: CLI entry (oclif)
code.summary: Entry of the ocbox and opencloudbox binaries. On Windows without SHELL it sets one from COMSPEC so oclif does not stall querying the parent process; oclif then finds commands in dist/commands.

code.name: Package export: contracts
code.summary: Public export opencloudbox/contracts: domain types, the error catalogue and the provider contract only, so importing it never starts the CLI.

code.name: Package export: infrastructure
code.summary: Public export opencloudbox/infrastructure: side-effect-free re-exports of agents, auth, config, credentials, execution, lifecycle, output, platform, providers, security, state and sync.

code.name: parseProjectConfig
code.summary: Parses opencloudbox.toml. A file over 1 MiB or invalid TOML is rejected; nine renamed fields (provider.type, version, environment…) fail with a pointer to the new name; the rest is validated by the strict ProjectConfigSchema.

code.name: migrateProjectConfig
code.summary: The only migration adds schemaVersion = 1 to a v0 file. Other versions and any credential-looking field or value are refused (migration_refused), and the result is re-validated before it is returned.

code.name: ProjectConfigSchema
code.summary: Strict schema of opencloudbox.toml: schemaVersion 1, provider, sandbox (OS, architecture, image, resources), network, lifecycle, source and non-secret env. Unknown keys are errors.

code.name: NetworkConfigSchema
code.summary: Restricted egress needs 1 to 256 unique allowed hosts (host[:port], port ≤ 65535); other egress modes must list none. Inbound is always blocked and previews are authenticated only.

code.name: LifecycleConfigSchema
code.summary: Timeouts in milliseconds: auto-destroy must come after auto-stop and may not precede the maximum runtime.

code.name: NonSecretEnvironmentSchema
code.summary: [env] values (up to 4096 characters) may not look like credentials or contain host paths, and names that look like provider credentials (token, key, password…) are rejected.

code.name: toSandboxSpec
code.summary: Converts the file shape into the provider-neutral sandbox spec used by lifecycle and providers. Env values are not copied, only the sorted variable names.

code.name: resolveConfigurationValue
code.summary: Value precedence: CLI flag, then environment variable, then project file, then default. An environment value that fails to parse raises an error naming the variable but not its value.

code.name: zodIssuesToDiagnostics
code.summary: Turns schema issues into diagnostics with a dotted path and, for unknown keys, a "did you mean" suggestion by edit distance. Messages carry paths, never values.

code.name: resolvePlatformPaths
code.summary: Per-OS folders. Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenCloudBox with a Credentials subfolder. Linux: $XDG_STATE_HOME/ocbox (default ~/.local/state/ocbox). macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/OpenCloudBox. A WSL /mnt/<drive> path gets no credential folder.

code.name: ExclusiveFileLock.withLock
code.summary: Runs an action while holding <file>.lock, created exclusively with owner pid and nonce. Defaults: wait 5 s, poll every 25 ms, a lock older than 30 s whose process is gone is taken over. Timeout or cancellation throws; the action never runs unlocked.

code.name: replaceFileAtomically
code.summary: Atomic rename over the destination. On Windows it retries up to 100 times with 5–50 ms back-off when antivirus or a reader holds the file (EACCES, EBUSY, EPERM); it never falls back to delete-and-move.

code.name: LocalStateStore
code.summary: Per-project JSON store <id>.json with a .lock file: validated load, save and update; secret-looking content is refused and a corrupt file is quarantined as .corrupt.<time>-<nonce>. Exported for embedding; no command in this repo calls it (CLI state uses AtomicJsonStore).

code.name: ProjectStateSchema
code.summary: Shape of that file: schemaVersion 1, activeSessionId and known Sessions (sandbox ids, provider, last manifest digest, sync baseline digests). The map key equals the Session id, one Sandbox maps to one Session, the active Session must exist.

code.name: ProtectedFileCredentialStore.set
code.summary: Writes <sha256 of kind, provider, account>.json through a temp file: opens it 0600 and verifies owner-only access on the empty file before any token byte is written, then fsyncs, renames and verifies again. A failed check removes the file.

code.name: ProtectedFileCredentialStore.get
code.summary: Checks the credential folder (0700, or owner-only ACL on Windows) and the file (owner-only, not a symlink), then parses it. Wrong key, bad JSON or schema gives CredentialFileCorruptionError; a failed protection check gives CredentialProtectionError.

code.name: HostedOAuthCredentialSchema
code.summary: Bearer credential: access token and optional refresh token up to 16384 characters each, an expiry and up to 256 scopes. The key (kind hosted-oauth, provider, account) is validated with it.

code.name: AuthMetadataStore
code.summary: auth.json in the state directory holds only issuer, client id, audience cli, scopes, expiry and the credential key, never a token. Reads and writes go through AtomicJsonStore; secret-looking content raises UnsafeAuthMetadataError.

code.name: createCredentialStore
code.summary: Builds the credential store. The OS-keychain adapter is never available in this build (UnavailableOsCredentialAdapter), so tokens use the protected-file store under the platform credential folder; an unsafe WSL folder raises CONFIG_INVALID.

code.name: resolveAuthEndpoints
code.summary: API base from --api-url, then OCBOX_API_URL, then the built-in default; authorize, token and revoke URLs derive from it. A credentialed or malformed URL raises CONFIG_INVALID. --authorize-url may name a separate browser origin.

code.name: createRefreshGate
code.summary: Wraps the session gate so token refresh, login, status and logout share one cross-process lock on the state directory. Two CLI processes can never present the same rotating refresh token.

code.name: PlatformBrowserOpener
code.summary: Opens the authorize URL with rundll32 (Windows), open (macOS) or xdg-open (Linux), never through a shell. Only http(s) URLs without spaces or quotes; gives up after 5 s and returns false, so login prints the URL for manual use.

code.name: authStatusLine
code.summary: Human lines for auth status, login and logout, including whether server revocation succeeded; structured output keeps the full view.

code.name: LoginRequiredError
code.summary: AUTH_REQUIRED failure telling the user to run ocbox auth login. AuthBindingError (AUTH_FORBIDDEN) means a credential exists but is not valid for this client, audience or scope.

code.name: SystemEntropy
code.summary: Operating-system random bytes for the PKCE verifier and state; the requested length must be between 1 and 65536.

code.name: Auth ports (browser, fetch)
code.summary: Injection points for login: BrowserOpenerPort, an unavailable-browser fallback and the Fetch shape used for every token and revocation call.

code.name: Auth clock
code.summary: Injectable wall clock (systemClock = Date.now) so expiry, skew and login timeouts stay deterministic.

code.name: AtomicJsonStore
code.summary: Schema-validated JSON file read and written under ExclusiveFileLock (reads too, to avoid Windows replace races). Write: 0600 temp file, fsync, atomic rename, folder fsync. delete retries up to 100 times and confirms the file is gone.

code.name: LifecycleProjectStateSchema
code.summary: Non-secret contents of a project's lifecycle file: selected Session, Sessions, Sandboxes, Operations with attempt counts, hosted mappings per login scope, pending create specs and the last fake execution per Sandbox.

code.name: projectIdForPath
code.summary: Derives a stable UUID-shaped project id from the SHA-256 of the working-directory path (lower-cased for Windows drive paths). The lifecycle file is <state>/lifecycle/<projectId>.json.

code.name: waitForCancellation
code.summary: Bounds a cancellation wait to 1 ms–2147483647 ms, polling every 100 ms. Deadline expiry gives OPERATION_TIMEOUT; a caller abort gives OPERATION_CANCELLED.

code.name: LifecycleService.#runMutation
code.summary: Pause, stop, resume, start, destroy: checks capability (pause needs memory_pause, stop needs filesystem_stop) and legal source states, saves a running Operation and a transitional state before calling the provider, and reuses a pending Operation of the same action; a different action conflicts.

code.name: LifecycleService.#createSession
code.summary: Create path: saves a Session in creating, a running create Operation (key create:<session>:<operation>, attempt 1) and the pending spec before any provider call. If another process already selected a Session, it continues that one.

code.name: LifecycleService.#continueCreate
code.summary: Sends the saved create to the provider with the stored idempotency key and bumps the attempt counter, so a restart resumes the same create. On success the Session becomes active; failures go to #recordFailure.

code.name: LifecycleService.#recordFailure
code.summary: A timeout or cancel is ambiguous (the provider may still be creating), so state is kept for recovery. Any other create failure marks the Operation failed and moves the Session to error.

code.name: LifecycleService.executionTarget
code.summary: Picks the Session for ocbox exec and checks it: active, exactly one active primary Sandbox binding, running locally and at the provider, and a provider that streams and cancels. It never creates or replaces a Session.

code.name: LifecycleService.cancelExecution
code.summary: Cancels an execution from another terminal (default wait 30 s). Resolves the local Sandbox, requires the hosted or fake provider, then asks it to cancel and wait for a terminal state.

code.name: parseExecArguments
code.summary: Parses --session, --cwd, --timeout (1–2147483647 ms), non-secret --env, output mode and either -- argv or --shell. Retains argv as an array here; the hosted provider later shell-quotes it into the API command string.

code.name: exitCodeForExecution
code.summary: CLI exit codes: the remote command's own exit code for a completed run, 124 on timeout, 125 for an infrastructure failure, 130 when cancelled.

code.name: validateTarget
code.summary: Requires an active Session, running primary Sandbox and streaming/cancellation support; checks the timeout and non-secret environment. Explicit --shell rejects a known non-Linux OS; null effective metadata is deferred to the executor.

code.name: createExecutionEventSink
code.summary: Human mode writes stdout and stderr bytes as they arrive; --json prints nothing until the end; --jsonl prints one base64-encoded event envelope per line. It waits for drain when the stream is back-pressured.

code.name: writeExecutionCompletion
code.summary: Final output: --json prints one result envelope with exit code, signal, timestamps and the retained stdout/stderr (base64); human mode prints "Execution timed out" or "Execution cancelled", or a safe infrastructure message, on stderr.

code.name: consumeExecutionOutput
code.summary: Pulls events one at a time and awaits the sink (back-pressure). Requires sequence 0, 1, 2… in order, started first, non-decreasing timestamps and exactly one completed event; any gap raises ExecutionStreamError. Keeps the first 64 KiB of each stream (limit 1 MiB).

code.name: runExecutionCommandResult
code.summary: Whole exec flow: parse, resolve the target, start, stream, then race completion against a second Ctrl-C (which forces exit as cancelled). Writes the final envelope and returns the exit code; started=false marks failures before the remote run began.

code.name: ocbox-execution-helper entry
code.summary: Entry of the ocbox-execution-helper binary: --protocol-version prints 1; other arguments exit 125. It reads one request from stdin, writes event frames to stdout, SIGINT/SIGTERM abort the command, and a failure before a terminal result exits 125.

code.name: LocalProcessExecutionHarness
code.summary: Runs a command as a local process on this machine through the helper, with a bounded event queue (default capacity 8; the producer waits when the consumer lags). A contract-test harness, not a sandbox and never offered as isolation.

code.name: FakeProviderExecution
code.summary: Execution port of the fake provider: starts a harness run, tracks it by execution id and cancels it on request (an unknown id rejects). rejectCancellation injects a failure for tests.

code.name: SyncBaselineStore
code.summary: Per Session files <state>/sync/<project>/<session>/baseline.json (last verified snapshot) and pending-baseline.json (intent saved before the target changes, promoted after). Only relative paths, hashes, modes and times; secret-looking content raises UNSAFE_BASELINE.

code.name: createVerifiedBaseline
code.summary: Builds the verified baseline from a scanned manifest: refuses a blocked or colliding manifest, drops excluded entries, sorts paths bytewise and stores the SHA-256 of the canonical snapshot, which is checked again when loaded.

code.name: builtInExclusion
code.summary: Non-overridable exclusions checked first, case-insensitively: .git, dependency folders (node_modules, vendor…), build output, .env*, key and certificate files, .ssh-style folders, credential files (.netrc, .npmrc…), cloud CLI stores and browser stores.

code.name: parseIgnoreRules
code.summary: Parses gitignore-style lines: ! re-includes, dir/ also matches its contents, a bare name matches at any depth. Absolute, .., backslash or NUL patterns throw InvalidIgnoreRuleError with the line number.

code.name: loadIgnoreRuleGroups
code.summary: Rule order: built-ins (never re-included), then .gitignore, then .opencloudboxignore, then --exclude and --include flags. A later group overrides earlier user rules; a missing file is skipped.

code.name: normalizeManifestPath
code.summary: Accepts only relative POSIX NFC paths (≤ 4096 bytes, segments ≤ 255). Rejects drive or UNC paths, backslashes, control characters, . and .., colons, trailing dot or space and Windows device names (CON, NUL, COM1…) with a ManifestPathError reason.

code.name: findPathCollisions
code.summary: Detects two names that become one on a case-insensitive or Unicode-normalizing host. They are reported as collisions and block the transfer, so one file cannot silently overwrite another.

code.name: resolveSyncContext
code.summary: Builds the sync context: loads config, resolves the selected Session, the local folder (default cwd) and the remote folder (default <state>/sync/<project>/<session>/remote). For provider ocbox --remote-dir is refused and a Sandbox must already exist (else INVALID_STATE, run ocbox start).

code.name: confirmSyncDeletion
code.summary: Asks "Apply destructive sync deletions? [y/N]" on stderr. Only a terminal without --json/--jsonl may prompt; otherwise deletions need --delete plus --yes.

code.name: TransferAdapter
code.summary: Provider-neutral transaction port: beginApply, stage entries from an archive, commit or roll back, plus recoveryStatus and recover. TransferError codes: INTEGRITY, RECOVERY_REQUIRED, REPLACE_NOT_APPROVED, UNSAFE_PATH, UNSAFE_TARGET.

code.name: createTransferAdapter
code.summary: Only provider fake has a local transfer adapter; any other name raises CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED, which recovery checks read as "nothing to recover".

code.name: withSyncLock
code.summary: Serializes sync mutations per Session with <state>/sync/<project>/<session>/sync.lock. Waits 5 s, then fails with OPERATION_CONFLICT instead of queueing.

code.name: reconcilePendingBaseline
code.summary: After a crash between commit and baseline write: if the target now matches the pending snapshot hash the baseline is promoted, otherwise the intent is discarded and the old baseline stays.

code.name: HOSTED_SOURCE_LIMITS
code.summary: Hosted upload caps: 1 MiB archive, 100 files, 64 KiB per file, 512 KiB in total.

code.name: firstSyncPlan
code.summary: No baseline yet: push or pull copies the source side when the target is empty, otherwise it reports a first-sync-target-not-empty conflict. diff reports that conflict when both sides already have files.

code.name: LocalTransferTransaction.commit
code.summary: Journals the swap as target-moving, target-moved, committed: the old target goes to backup, the prepared copy is renamed into place, then backup and journal are deleted. A crash at any step leaves a journal that recover can resolve.

code.name: ProviderRegistry.resolve
code.summary: Looks up a factory by slug (lower-case, ≤ 63 characters) and builds the provider. An unknown name raises CONFIG_INVALID; a factory that throws raises PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.

code.name: ProviderRegistry.diagnostics
code.summary: Builds each registered provider and asks for its capabilities (used by ocbox providers). A provider that cannot be built is reported unavailable (PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE) instead of failing the command.

code.name: createOcboxProvider
code.summary: Builds the issuer-bound hosted provider with a required project, durable operation checkpoints and a pinned login/project mapping scope. Scope checks and fetch dispatch hold auth.state.lock; response waits release it.

code.name: resolvePrimaryBinding
code.summary: Chooses the one active primary sandbox binding of a hosted Session (ordered by ordinal, releasedAt null). Several active bindings, a non-primary active binding or a pointer that disagrees raise INVALID_STATE.

code.name: assertOwnedSession
code.summary: A hosted Session whose project differs from the configured hosted project is reported as PROJECT_NOT_FOUND, with no hint that the Session exists.

code.name: requestedSpecFromConfig
code.summary: Turns the config into hosted request fields: cpu in cores (millicores / 1000), memory in bytes, image, region, runtime. Only fields present in the file are sent so the server picks its default; CLI flags override them.

code.name: admissionError
code.summary: Maps server denial codes to plain messages: spec_not_allowed → INVALID_SPEC, admission_closed → PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, user_active_limit → USAGE_LIMIT, global_capacity → PROVIDER_CAPACITY, budget_exhausted → INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS.

code.name: resolvePollDelayMilliseconds
code.summary: Poll delay: a server Retry-After wins (header values over one day are ignored when parsed); otherwise exponential back-off from 250 ms, doubling up to 30 s, with up to 20% jitter.

code.name: Deadline
code.summary: Absolute deadline from an injectable clock, shared across one wait; remainingMilliseconds and exceeded drive the polling loops.

code.name: FileOperationCheckpointStore
code.summary: Keeps the last seen state of each hosted Operation in <state>/ocbox-operation-checkpoints.json (attempt, progress 0–100, request id), so a restarted CLI returns a terminal result without calling the API.

code.name: HOSTED_CAPABILITIES
code.summary: What the hosted provider advertises: container runtime, streaming and cancellable execution, filesystem kept on stop, no memory pause, no archive, no file API, authenticated HTTP previews, commands up to 3 600 000 ms, one Sandbox per Session.

code.name: executionWaitDeadlineMilliseconds
code.summary: How long the CLI collects output: the requested timeout, else the provider maximum (3 600 000 ms), else 5 min, plus 30 s of grace so a long command is not cut off while running.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.uploadSource
code.summary: Source upload entry: the mapped hosted Session must still exist and its primary binding must match the stored sandbox and be running, else INVALID_STATE "run ocbox start". Then uploadPreparedSource runs with deduplication.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.#saveRecord
code.summary: Stores the local-to-hosted sandbox mapping in the lifecycle file under the login scope (a hash of issuer, identity, login time, expiry and project), so another login or project cannot reuse it.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.#createPreview
code.summary: Creates an authenticated preview: ttl clamped to 60–86400 s, and the returned URL must match the requested protocol and carry no credentials (else PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE). A provider capability; no ocbox command calls it.

code.name: ProviderFiles
code.summary: File API a provider may implement: read, write, list, stat, checksum, makeDirectory, remove, move. The hosted provider answers CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED for all of them.

code.name: PreviewSchema
code.summary: Result contract: a succeeded preview_create Operation for the same Sandbox, authenticated true, a URL without credentials whose scheme matches the protocol (http, https, ws, wss).

code.name: ApplySourceResultSchema
code.summary: Result contract for applying source: a succeeded source_apply Operation for the same Sandbox and a 64-hex SHA-256 content digest.

code.name: FakeProviderStateSchema
code.summary: Fake provider state <state>/providers/fake.json: resources by provider id, idempotency key to resource, and one-time lost-response markers that make retry paths testable.

code.name: OcboxApiClient.assertSuccess
code.summary: Returns the body with request id, replay flag and status when the status is expected; otherwise maps status and the public error envelope (code, message, retry-after) to a stable OcboxError. Authorization and idempotency-key headers are managed and cannot be supplied by callers.

code.name: createClient (generated)
code.summary: Generated from openapi/openapi.yaml (checksum in the file header); regenerate with pnpm run api:generate and never edit by hand. Builds the typed client; every mutating call requires an idempotency key.

code.name: runMetadataAction
code.summary: Validates input (name 1–200 characters, limit 1–100, idempotency key), calls the generated client, expects 201 for create and 200 otherwise, and checks the response against strict schemas. Other errors become "Hosted metadata request failed" or cancelled.

code.name: MetadataCommand
code.summary: Base of project and environment commands: Ctrl-C aborts the request through an AbortSignal, and output is "id name" lines plus nextCursor= for paging.

code.name: Branded identifiers
code.summary: Ids are branded opaque UUIDs or ULIDs (Project, Session, Sandbox, Operation, Execution, Request) so they cannot be mixed up. Provider ids are separate printable strings (≤ 256); idempotency keys are 16–200 characters of [A-Za-z0-9._:-].

code.name: ExecCommandSchema
code.summary: A command is either structured argv (1–4096 items, each ≤ 32768 characters, no NUL) or one shell string (≤ 1 MiB); the environment holds at most 128 variables.

code.name: SandboxPath
code.summary: A path inside the sandbox: 1–4096 characters, no NUL, branded so a host path cannot be passed where a sandbox path is expected.

code.name: UtcTimestampSchema
code.summary: Only canonical UTC strings with milliseconds (…T00:00:00.000Z) that round-trip through Date#toISOString; used for every persisted time.

code.name: SESSION_TRANSITIONS
code.summary: The Session state machine over 10 states: creating leads to active, destroying or error; destroyed is terminal; error can recover to active, paused, stopped or destroyed.

code.name: assertSessionTransition
code.summary: The edge must exist in SESSION_TRANSITIONS, transitional states need an Operation id, and a move to active, paused, stopped or destroyed needs a fresh provider observation of the matching state (destroyed also needs a deletion time).

code.name: OutputWriter
code.summary: One writer for human, --json (indented) and --jsonl output. Results and events go to stdout, errors and progress to stderr. Every envelope (schemaVersion 1, kind, name, timestamp, data) passes through redactForOutput; colour only on a TTY without NO_COLOR.

code.name: OcboxError
code.summary: Stable public error: code, message, retryable flag taken from the registry, request id, optional provider code and redacted details. The schema rejects details with secret-looking keys, host paths or raw errors.

code.name: OCBOX_ERROR_REGISTRY
code.summary: 32 error codes, each marked retryable or not. Retryable: PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT, PROVIDER_TIMEOUT, OPERATION_TIMEOUT, SYNC_INTEGRITY and others; not retryable: AUTH_REQUIRED, INVALID_STATE, SYNC_CONFLICT and others.

code.name: redactForOutput
code.summary: Secret-like keys, command output keys (stdout, stderr, argv) and token-shaped strings become [REDACTED]; host paths become [LOCAL_PATH]; cycles become [CIRCULAR]. Applied to every CLI envelope.

code.name: findSensitiveMaterial
code.summary: Scans a value for credential fields, secret-looking strings, local paths and command output, returning schema paths only (never the value). Used to refuse persisting auth metadata, sync baselines and config with secrets.

code.name: sanitizeTelemetryPayload
code.summary: Flat allow-list of 15 fields (event, code, durations, ids…). Only booleans, finite numbers and short safe strings (≤ 128 characters) survive. No command in this repo calls it.

code.name: assertPathWithinDirectoryRoot
code.summary: Shared by both agent adapters: resolves the deepest existing ancestor through real paths and refuses a target that escapes its containing folder or hides behind a dangling link (PathBoundaryViolation).

code.name: runCodexAgentHookSafely
code.summary: Fail-closed boundary of ocbox agent hook codex: a routed call prints the PreToolUse deny and exits 0; an unreadable payload, missing Session or any unexpected error is redacted and becomes a deny with exit 2.

code.name: Safe execution error detail
code.summary: Extracts only code/message from normalized OcboxError or its immediate wrapped cause and known argument/context errors. Unknown errors have no optional detail; raw causes, paths and output are not serialized.

code.name: resolveSyncContext
code.summary: Resolve selected Session, running sandbox and hosted mapping before selecting v2 or legacy upload.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.sourceCasTransport
code.summary: Only an owned running sandbox mapped to a sesdo_ Session gets a v2 transport; older Sessions keep legacy upload.

code.name: createCasTransport
code.summary: Authenticated generated plan/apply calls use stable keys, strict receipts and safe errors, with at most 3 attempts.

code.name: runCasPush
code.summary: Scan safely under the Session lock, scope unsigned pending/success state by API/Session/root, require deletion approval and preserve resumable identity only for unchanged pages younger than 45 minutes.

code.name: buildCasSnapshot
code.summary: Build canonical pages capped at 512 entries and 512 KiB, at most 512 pages, 4096 blobs and 32 MiB metadata.

code.name: packCasFiles
code.summary: Reuses slices with matching file hash/size and verified cached blobs; otherwise packs into 8 MiB bundles or 16 MiB parts. With previous state and at most 512 dirty files, small files become separate blobs.

code.name: readCasState
code.summary: Strictly validate unsigned metadata and page hashes before using cached content; malformed state fails closed.

code.name: writeCasState
code.summary: Writes unsigned snapshot metadata to a 0600 exclusive temporary file and renames it over the destination; removes the temporary file afterward. No fsync or capability URL persistence.

code.name: readCasBlob
code.summary: Open cached blobs without following links and verify size and SHA-256 before reuse or PUT.

code.name: validateCasPages
code.summary: Check exact page hashes, unique paths, declared blob slices and manifest counts/bytes before accepting unsigned state.

code.name: syncCasSnapshot
code.summary: Plans each page and verifies missing blobs; performs credential-free capability PUTs with 4 workers, 120-second attempt timers and 3 attempts. Replays matching apply receipts at 1-second intervals under a 15-minute loop deadline.

code.name: dispatchMetadataAction
code.summary: Dispatches the eight metadata actions, checks names (1–200), pagination (1–100) and mutation keys; requires 201 for creates or 200 otherwise and validates resource/page schemas.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.get
code.summary: Loads the current scoped mapping and owned hosted Session; a changed primary binding fails INVALID_STATE. Returns the observed Sandbox without persisting its refreshed state.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.list
code.summary: Reads one listSessions page, retains project-owned active primary bindings with existing local mappings and optional local Session/project filters. CLI ls reads local state instead.

code.name: hostedSpecification
code.summary: Only a complete valid hosted effectiveSpec becomes observed Sandbox metadata. Absent/partial data remains null; the requested local specification is never promoted.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.#cancelExecution
code.summary: Aborts the tracked event collector, posts cancelExecution and, for durable mappings, waits up to 30 seconds for terminal execution observation before removing the in-process handle.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.#revokePreview
code.summary: Resolves a preview URL from the in-process map, calls deletePreview with the mutation key and removes the local URL mapping after HTTP 200/202. No CLI command invokes this port.

code.name: cancelHostedOperation
code.summary: Embedded helper retries cancelOperation with the same validated key under a 5-minute deadline, rejecting non-cancellable states. It returns a validated response; no CLI command calls it or waits here for terminal cancellation.

code.name: CAS_LIMITS
code.summary: V2 limits: 8 MiB bundles, 16 MiB parts, 512-entry/512 KiB pages, 512 pages, 4096 blobs, 32 MiB metadata; 4 PUT workers, 3 attempts, 120-second PUT timers, 900-second apply loop.

code.name: uploadTarget
code.summary: Accepts opaque HTTPS capability URLs, or HTTP on loopback only; rejects embedded credentials and fragments before PUT. Does not infer the endpoint storage vendor.

code.name: parallel
code.summary: Starts at most 4 upload workers, stops scheduling after a failure and awaits every active worker with allSettled before releasing the outer Session lock.

code.name: casRefusal
code.summary: Maps recognized status/reason categories into safe auth, unsupported, size, integrity, conflict, rate-limit or generic sync errors; raw server text and capability URLs never enter messages.

code.name: casHash
code.summary: Recursively sorts object keys, preserves array order and hashes canonical JSON with SHA-256 to identify source pages independently of object insertion order.

code.name: SessionSchema
code.summary: Validates ordered same-Session bindings, at most one active primary, stable-state provider evidence, transitional Operation IDs and verified deletion before a Session becomes destroyed.

code.name: SandboxSchema
code.summary: Validates provider identity, lifecycle/specification observations and canonical timestamps within the Sandbox record lifetime.

code.name: OperationSchema
code.summary: Requires ordered timestamps, state-appropriate completion times and idempotency resolution on success; lifecycle success additionally needs provider verification and a Sandbox ID.

code.name: OperationContextSchema
code.summary: Mutation context extends request ID/time with persisted Operation ID, idempotency key and positive attempt number so provider retries can replay or adopt effects.

code.name: createAuthenticatedTransport
code.summary: Adapts generated JSON requests to issuer-bound bearer transport, checks duplicate idempotency headers and body type, then bounds response reads with cancellation, size and separate deadlines.

code.name: AuthSessionService.#commit
code.summary: Snapshots both stores under the auth gate, writes the new credential then metadata and restores the prior pair after metadata failure; incomplete restoration raises INVALID_STATE.

code.name: FakeSandboxProvider.#mutate
code.summary: Replays mutation keys from local state, rejects missing/deleted resources, writes the target state and idempotency result, and can intentionally lose one response to exercise lifecycle recovery.

code.name: recordLocalAuthFailure
code.summary: Keeps the last 100 auth failure references for seven days in auth-failures.json, using the atomic local store. Only timestamp, reason and optional server reference are retained.

code.name: serverAuthReason
code.summary: Maps closed public server reason codes to fixed messages and next steps. Unknown response text is never displayed.

journeys.name: Sign in from the CLI
journeys.summary: From ocbox auth login to stored credentials: PKCE sign-in in the browser on a loopback port, token exchange and protected storage.

steps.story: Generate PKCE and state, bind 127.0.0.1 on a random port and open the browser authorization page; the listener accepts only one matching callback.

on_failure.story: Wrong or replayed state is refused; cancellation and timeout close the listener without storing tokens.

steps.story: Exchange the authorization code with its original verifier; validate the response before persisting credentials under the auth state lock.
Store bearer material through the credential port and non-secret metadata separately; a failed metadata commit rolls back the prior generation.

Failures carry a closed reason and next step. Auth errors are recorded by local reference; server references are retained when supplied. A browser that never returns reaches the finite callback deadline. Logout reports why revocation was skipped or failed.

journeys.name: Start a box from the CLI
journeys.summary: From ocbox start to an active hosted Session: create, poll the operation, confirm the Session, save local state.

steps.story: The lifecycle checks selected local Session state. A resumable Session is reconciled; otherwise creation saves a local operation before the request.
The hosted provider sends `createSession` with an idempotency key and retains the returned running operation for bounded recovery.
Poll the operation with Retry-After and a default 5-minute deadline; terminal success is checked against the hosted Session before local state becomes active.

on_failure.story: A timeout preserves recoverable Session evidence and returns OPERATION_TIMEOUT; it does not pretend the server cancelled the create.

journeys.name: Push local files to the box
journeys.summary: Select CAS v2 for mapped sesdo_ Sessions or legacy hosted archive delivery; fake-provider push uses the separate local transfer journey.

steps.story: Select the transport through the persisted hosted Session mapping: sesdo_ follows the content-addressed resume journey; older hosted Sessions follow the bounded archive steps below, refusing files over 64 KiB.
Legacy hosted push scans the folder, excluding sensitive/unsafe paths; refuses remote deletion, files over 64 KiB, more than 100 files or more than 512 KiB total.
Encode and hash an archive capped at 1 MiB; list verified receipts to avoid replaying an obsolete snapshot after an A→B→A change.
Create a `source manifest` with content and lineage-derived idempotency keys; the hosted Session must still accept source work.
Upload checksum-verified chunks, retrying a retryable failure at most 3 times; a 409 is accepted only when the returned chunk checksum matches.

on_failure.story: A chunk with the wrong local SHA-256 or a conflicting server checksum fails SYNC_INTEGRITY; a retryable upload error is retried at most 3 times with the same idempotency key.

steps.story: Verify the complete source and poll a returned apply operation on a 1-second healthy interval within a default 5-minute deadline.

on_failure.story: Incomplete source or checksum mismatch returns a typed integrity failure. Success requires a matching manifest, checksum and chunk count.

journeys.name: Run a command from the CLI
journeys.summary: Run a command in the Session's box, stream its output and return its exit code.

steps.story: Resolve the selected Session and provider capabilities; validate bindings and deadlines. Explicit shell rejects a known non-Linux OS; an unobserved effective specification remains unknown and the remote executor decides shell compatibility.
The hosted provider submits `createExecution` under an idempotency key and retains the returned pending execution handle.
Collect output by cursor and increasing sequence, skipping duplicates; after bounded stream failures the collector polls until its deadline.
Read the terminal result and map its exit code. Event/result collection failure attempts remote cancellation; the first Ctrl-C requests cancellation and a repeated interrupt forces local exit 130.

on_failure.story: A transport timeout is not proof the remote command stopped. Cancellation must converge to a terminal result or surface a typed failure.

A typed event/result error after an accepted start retains the safe code/message in human, JSON and JSONL output. Exit 125 still identifies infrastructure failure; unknown causes retain the generic envelope.

journeys.name: A coding agent's command runs in the box
journeys.summary: A Claude Code Bash call is denied locally and run in the Session instead, through the owned PreToolUse hook.

steps.story: A `PreToolUse` event reaches the owned adapter hook. Guard rules decide whether the command may run in the selected Session.
The hook invokes ocbox exec with a 570000 ms remote deadline inside the configured 600-second hook timeout, leaving a 30-second decision margin.
After the remote result the hook emits a blocking `deny` decision so the covered command is not repeated locally; guard refusal also emits a deny.

on_failure.story: Setup checks pinned versions and capability gates; unsupported configurations fail before editing an agent settings file.

journeys.name: Destroy a box from the CLI
journeys.summary: Destroy the hosted Session, confirm it is gone, then remove the local mapping.

steps.story: Require --yes or interactive y before dispatch, then load the selected Session and save a pending destroy Operation. A refused confirmation returns INVALID_STATE before a provider mutation.
Send destroySession with its idempotency key and poll the operation under the lifecycle deadline.

Observe destroyed state with no primary binding, or a 404, before marking the hosted mapping deleted. Lifecycle retains the destroyed Session, completed Operation and released bindings as local history.

on_failure.story: A server destroy still pending returns a typed failure; retaining the mapping allows a later retry and reconciliation.

journeys.name: Refresh CLI tokens
journeys.summary: Refresh an expiring access token under the cross-process lock without reusing a rotated refresh token.

steps.story: A credential approaching expiry is checked against issuer, client, audience and scope metadata while the cross-process auth state lock is held.
Rotate through `exchangeCliToken`. Another process adopts a newer generation rather than reusing the superseded refresh token.
Replace the matching credential generation; replay-safe HTTP requests can retry once after a 401, while unsafe mutations surface the failure.

on_failure.story: Revoked or reused refresh material clears the matching generation and returns `AUTH_REQUIRED`; another process's newer login is retained.

journeys.name: Inspect CLI authentication
journeys.summary: Report whether the CLI is logged in, from local metadata and the protected credential only.

steps.story: Load auth metadata and its credential reference under the state lock; tokens are never printed.

Validate credential identity, canonical issuer, expected client and matching scopes under the state lock. Missing credentials clear stale metadata and return signed-out status; inconsistent stores raise INVALID_STATE.
Emit logged-in/expired status with issuer, audience, scopes and expiry from the safe status view. No network request or token refresh is performed by auth status.

Failures carry a closed reason and next step. Auth errors are recorded by local reference; server references are retained when supplied. A browser that never returns reaches the finite callback deadline. Logout reports why revocation was skipped or failed.

journeys.name: Sign the CLI out
journeys.summary: Revoke the token when possible, then always clear local credentials and metadata.

steps.story: Acquire `auth.state.lock` and load the current credential generation before server revocation or local cleanup.
Attempt public token revocation; this network effect is followed by local cleanup even when the request fails.
Clear both local stores and report cleanup failures as INVALID_STATE; secret token values never enter command output.

Failures carry a closed reason and next step. Auth errors are recorded by local reference; server references are retained when supplied. A browser that never returns reaches the finite callback deadline. Logout reports why revocation was skipped or failed.

journeys.name: Resume a stopped box
journeys.summary: Start a stopped or paused Session again and wait until the hosted Session is running.

steps.story: Validate the local Session state and save a pending lifecycle operation before calling the hosted API.
Send the requested mutation with an idempotency key; capability or Session state refusal returns a typed error.
Poll and reconcile the hosted Session before saving the resulting local state; a deadline failure preserves recovery evidence.

journeys.name: Pause a box
journeys.summary: Pause a Session when the provider advertises memory pause; the hosted provider does not, so the CLI refuses before any request.

steps.story: Validate the local Session and check the provider capability first: memory pause is required, and the hosted provider advertises none, so ocbox pause fails with CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED before any request or local change.

on_failure.story: The refusal is raised before an Operation is saved, so the Session state stays active and nothing needs recovery.

steps.story: Reached only for a provider that advertises memory pause: pauseSession is sent with an idempotency key; capability or Session state refusal returns a typed error.
Poll and reconcile the hosted Session before saving the resulting local state; a deadline failure preserves recovery evidence.

journeys.name: Stop a box
journeys.summary: Stop a Session (filesystem kept) and wait until the hosted Session is stopped.

steps.story: Validate the local Session state and save a pending lifecycle operation before calling the hosted API.
Send the requested mutation with an idempotency key; capability or Session state refusal returns a typed error.
